declarations.description:
The header chip on its own (for a header an element builds itself, like a
disclosure row). Done: the icon becomes o.doneIcon (icons:check-box), the
chip gets data-done and o.doneLabel as its hover text, and it holds the
burst celebrateDDDCompletion plays. The chip stays aria-hidden; speak the
state with renderDDDBlockChipLabel next to the block's label.

state shown by the chip is also spoken; nothing when not done or when
speakDone is false.

declarations.name: celebrateDDDCompletion
declarations.description:
Play the completion burst once on target (a .ddd-block-chip, a progress
ring or anything holding renderDDDBurst): data-ddd-celebrate is set for a
moment and the styles in DDDCompletionStyles animate it. Does nothing,
and returns false, with reduced motion or without a target.

Decides when something watched over time (a page percent, an item) has
just been finished for the first time: update(key, done) is true only
when key was seen not done before and is done now, once per key. The
first value seen for a key never counts, so something already done when
it is shown (a revisit, a reload) does not celebrate.

members.name: forget

Stop watching key (it is no longer shown); the next value seen for it
is a first look again. Keys that already celebrated never do again.

declarations.description:
Internal consistency contracts (cross-cutting; apply to element internals).
These are what the hax-pattern-library-audit skill grades and what later
application work would enforce. Defining them is in scope; mass-enforcing
across 226 elements is NOT (see plan scope boundary).

declarations.name: resolveHaxCapabilityReport
declarations.description:
HAX-capability gate. Returns a report of which referenced components are
verified HAX-capable, which are excluded (non-HAX), and which are unverified.
Patterns whose components include an excluded tag are flagged so the stax
wiring does not publish them; the audit skill surfaces these as gaps.

declarations.description:
Helper: which internal contracts apply to a given element tag.
Used by the audit skill to know which contracts to grade for an element.

declarations.name: getPatternsUsingComponent
declarations.description:
Helper: which patterns include a given component tag (composition conformance
lookup for the audit skill).

declarations.name: publishDDDPatternsToHax
declarations.description:
Publish all gate-passing patterns to the HAX store. Called once the store
is ready and DDD is the active design system. Respects platformAllows
gating for blockTemplates (area) and pageTemplates (page).
Async because each pattern's HTML recipe must be converted to HAX element
objects via store.htmlToHaxElements() before registering.

type.text: Promise<{registeredStax: string[], registeredOverrides: string[], skipped: object[], gaps: object[]}>

declarations.name: activateDDDPatternStax

active design system, then publishes. Safe to call multiple times; the
store flag prevents double-registration.

declarations.description:

patterns were gated and why.

declarations.description:
The controls every admin surface shares, as the HaxUiAdminControls and
HaxUiAdminFieldRow design-system cards describe them. Spread after
HaxUiAdminTokens and use the classes instead of restyling a button,
switch or input in each element.

- .hax-ui-btn (secondary), .hax-ui-btn.primary, .hax-ui-btn.ghost,
  .hax-ui-btn.danger (outline, opens a confirm), .hax-ui-btn.danger-fill
  (the final commit); 32px, words beside a 16px icon
- .hax-ui-icon-btn: 32px square, needs aria-label
- .hax-ui-seg: segmented control of buttons with aria-pressed
- .hax-ui-chip, .hax-ui-chip[data-set]: filter chips
- .hax-ui-switch: a button with role="switch" and aria-checked
- .hax-ui-input, .hax-ui-select: 40px field controls;
  add .compact for a 32px toolbar control (search, filters)
- .hax-ui-field-row with .hax-ui-field-label (label + p help) and
  .hax-ui-field-control
- .hax-ui-message[data-tone="warning|danger|info"] under a control
- .hax-ui-callout[data-tone="warning|info"]
- .hax-ui-message with no tone: a muted note box (status, hints);
  .hax-ui-note: the same note as plain muted text
- .hax-ui-empty: empty state
- .hax-ui-tool-field: a labelled toolbar field, a bordered row holding
  a short muted label and a bare select or input; .grow to fill
- .hax-ui-seg.fill: a segmented control whose buttons share the width
  equally; .hax-ui-seg.wrap lets a long one wrap
- .hax-ui-chip[aria-pressed]: a toggle chip (solid; pressed is the
  accent), with an optional .n count
- .hax-ui-tokens / .hax-ui-token: removable tokens in a field, each
  with a remove button, and a bare input to add more
- .hax-ui-input-group: an input joined to its unit (.unit); .warning

declarations.description:
A settings form in a narrow side panel (the editor tray's Configure
form): put class="hax-ui-side-panel" on the simple-fields form. Each
setting is one row with a label column and the control filling the rest,
rows divided by a line, every text field and select one 32px control,
and pickers (icon, color) bordered the same way. The admin field row
(240px label column, 40px inputs) does not fit a 300px panel, so this is
its compact form. Opt-in: not part of HaxUiAdminStyles.

declarations.name: HaxUiAdminIcons
declarations.description:
One name per admin meaning. Admin chrome uses the hax:admin-* family
only (see "Admin icons" in hax-ui-admin.md); pick the icon by what it
means here instead of typing a name, so every surface draws the same
glyph for the same action:

  <simple-icon-lite icon="${HaxUiAdminIcons.close}"></simple-icon-lite>

Section icons (the rail, panel groups, system settings) have keys
here too, named for the section (structure, appearance, seo...), so a
section draws the same glyph wherever it is listed.
Content icons (block icons, hax:file-*, brand marks) are not admin
chrome and stay what they are.

HAX UI admin tokens: the semantic layer admin surfaces (outline designer,
dashboard, dialogs, trays) style themselves with. Every value maps to a
DDD primitive; surface, text and accent defer to the HAX UI theme tokens
(--hax-ui-background-color, --hax-ui-color, --hax-ui-color-accent) when

token on the element from outside. Admin elements use these tokens
instead of raw values or DDD content tokens, and new needs are added
here, mapped to DDD, before an element uses them.
See haxtheweb/issues#3180.

declarations.description:
`hax-confirm-dialog`
The HAX UI confirm card's body: a muted message and the HAX UI buttons
(cancel plain and focused first, confirm primary, or a danger fill when
destructive). Open it in a simple-modal with HaxUiDialogConfirm. It
lives in d-d-d with the rest of the HAX UI layer so hax-body's dialogs
and HAXcms's share one confirm; the old haxcms-elements path re-exports
it.
declarations.name: HAXConfirmDialog

declarations.description:
`hax-palette-picker`
A radio-style palette selector that writes values compatible with `data-palette`.

Value contract:
- `value` is the canonical `data-palette` attribute value (for example `"5"`).
- `selectedKey` is the associated palette key (for example `"monotone"`).
- Emits `value-changed` with `{ value, key, dataPalette, option }`.
declarations.name: HaxPalettePicker
